limitations: No fresh unit rerun: historical native unit applicability rests on matching source/configuration identities plus the retained completed reviews. The original unit Git object is not locally reconstructed.
Unit logs retain success totals rather than every successful word; original reviewers inspected the executed harness and original binary.
Forced causal compute pressure is dense NRC16 RS only. The eight tail cycles do not each prove the full upstream conjunction.
The processor sparse witness proves the actual observed transactions. No same-cycle release/issue occurred, and none is claimed as runtime coverage.
Native tensor/scalar floating-point paths retain inherited integer/utility DPI in processor rtlsim; whole-processor no-DPI is unclaimed.
Omitted library/tool/dependency/source bodies retain identity-only publication scope where specified. Export integrity is not binary replay or origin authentication.
RSS/disk enforcement is polled, source stability is observed at checkpoints, dependencies are reused identified inputs, and resource figures are host observations.

No arbitrary geometry, sparse BF16/RS, scaled formats, FEDP2K, LDST_MATRIX, universal IEEE behavior, event-level timing identity, full-AFU, vendor hw_emu, physical FPGA, synthesis/PPA or silicon claim.
No compiler, GPU execution, test suite or subagent was invoked by this acceptance reviewer; only read-only evidence analysis and review-file writes were performed.
review_method_note: The reviewer independently reparsed all final arithmetic/counter logs and rejoined all sparse metadata event chains, rehashed final artifacts and receipt bindings, then rechecked all 1,908 consumed identities. One initial reader assertion compared two equivalent verifier-source inventories in incidental list order; inspection proved exact path-to-identity equality and the reader was corrected to compare inventories by path. This was a reviewer helper ordering assumption, not a packet/verifier/GPU failure or a gate change.
